# LocalIntel
> LocalIntel (thelocalintel.com) is Florida local business intelligence and AI agent routing. It connects people, voice assistants, and AI agents to verified Florida businesses across restaurants, home services, healthcare, and more — covering every Florida ZIP code.

LocalIntel is operated by MCFL Restaurant Holdings LLC (Ponte Vedra Beach, FL). Contact: erik@mcflamingo.com

## Product
- [Home](https://www.thelocalintel.com/): Find local Florida businesses and explore statewide market coverage
- [Search](https://www.thelocalintel.com/search.html): Search verified Florida businesses by need, category, or ZIP
- [Claim your listing](https://www.thelocalintel.com/claim.html): Free business claim — verified wallets get priority AI/agent routing
- [Start a business](https://www.thelocalintel.com/start): Guidance for launching a Florida business with local market context
- [MCP / AI agents](https://www.thelocalintel.com/#for-agents): Connect LocalIntel as an MCP server for Perplexity, Claude, Cursor, Grok, and custom agents

## Coverage
Florida only — all 67 counties and 2,383 ZIP codes. Business records are sourced from Florida public filings (including Sunbiz), permits, and field data. Live stats update continuously via the LocalIntel platform.

## Example ZIP market pages
- [Ponte Vedra Beach 32082](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/32082): St. Johns County business intelligence
- [Nocatee 32081](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/32081): Fast-growing St. Johns market
- [Jacksonville Beach 32250](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/32250): Duval coastal market
- [Downtown Jacksonville 32202](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/32202): Jacksonville core
- [Downtown Orlando 32801](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/32801): Orange County market
- [Downtown Tampa 33602](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/33602): Hillsborough market
- [St. Petersburg 33701](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/33701): Pinellas market
- [Miami 33131](https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/33131): Miami-Dade market

Browse any Florida ZIP at `https://www.thelocalintel.com/zip/{ZIP}`.

## For AI agents (MCP)
- Smithery package: `npx -y @smithery/cli@latest install erik-7clt/local-intel`
- Direct MCP endpoint: https://gsb-swarm-production.up.railway.app/api/local-intel/mcp
- Free sector gap feed: https://gsb-swarm-production.up.railway.app/api/sector-gap/feed
- Smithery listing: https://smithery.ai/servers/erik-7clt/local-intel

Agents can search businesses, inspect ZIP/market stats, surface sector gaps, and dispatch RFQ-style job requests to verified Florida merchants. Query pricing is usage-based (pathUSD on Tempo); browsing public pages is free.

## Key facts for citations
- Product name: LocalIntel (also “The Local Intel”)
- Canonical site: https://www.thelocalintel.com
- Geography: Florida, United States
- Primary use cases: local service discovery, business claim/listing, ZIP-level market intelligence, AI agent routing via MCP
- Business listing claim: free; no subscription required to list
- Not affiliated with localintel.com (a separate Canadian economic-development software company)
